# Changelog: 3.1.0-beta (from 2.0.5)

## Major Changes

### Keybinds
* **H** — Toggle widget on/off (restores last selected recipe when re-enabled)
* **P** — Open Positioning HUD directly

### Recipes / Backend
* Significantly expanded recipe and resource tracking using NEU-Repo
* Recipe and resource lists now update automatically on every game launch

### Widget Customization
* Positioning preview now uses live SandboxWidget visuals, showing a static tree that mirrors your current expansion state (non-interactive)
* Materials and recipe tree unified into a single scrollable, responsively scaled panel
* Vertical (line height) and lateral (indent) scaling; per-node and header text scales down with an upper cap
* Craftable block always rendered below the tree and persists across scroll
* Interaction fixes: stable corner resize (no snap-back), live drag preview, hit-testing accurately matches visuals

### Version Management
* Recipe files are automatically reinitialised on mod upgrade — no manual reset needed going forward

> ⚠️ **First-time upgrade only:** Please run `/ir reset` after installing to recalibrate for the expanded resource list. Feedback is appreciated!

## Changelog: 3.0.0-beta (from 2.0.5)

### Major Changes

1. Keybinds

- H —> Toggle widget on/off (restores last selected recipe when re-enabled).
- P —> Open Positioning HUD directly

2. Recipes / backend

- Increased number of recipes and resources to track while in game (uses NEU-Repo)
- Updates the recipes and resources whenever launching the game

3. Widget customization

- Positioning preview uses SandboxWidget visuals, shows a static tree that follows your viewer expansion state (non-interactive).
- Materials and recipe tree are one scrollable, responsively scaled panel:
- Vertical (line height) and lateral (indent) scaling; per-node/header text scales down with an upper cap.
- Craftable block always rendered below the tree and persists.
- Interaction fixes: stable corner resize (no snap-back), live preview follows drag, hit-testing matches visuals.

**_Upon downloading the new version, please run the command `/ir reset` to start calibrating for new resources being tracked._**
Feedback will be valuable!
